label: Diagram 2.33
caption: Diagram 2.33 Wall type 3 – internal timber floor
description: The drawing is a section, as indicated by the word "SECTION" in the lower right corner. The title at the top reads "Diagram 2.33 Wall type 3 – internal timber floor". It shows a vertical wall element crossing a horizontal floor element, forming a cross or plus shape at the centre of the image. The wall is drawn running top to bottom, with a hatched central core and a single vertical line on each side of it. The floor is drawn as a horizontal band formed by two horizontal lines that passes behind the wall. Where the two meet, a sloping line and a short vertical line form a bracket on each side of the wall within the floor band, and a small dot symbol is placed at each of these points. A label reading "Hanger", with a leader line, points to the dot symbol on the left-hand side of the junction. No dimensions or further text are shown.
